key_points.evidence_quote: Opening question: was Bach his era's Bieber, and will Bieber be our era's Bach?
key_points.point_text: Bach-Bieber hook: are canons popularity plus time, and will Bieber be our Bach
key_points.reasoning: Both directions of the question captured.

key_points.evidence_quote: We remember fewer than 20 of 200 to 500 Viennese contemporaries and 3,400 catalogued composers
key_points.point_text: Base rates (200-500 Viennese, 3,400 catalogued, under 20 remembered) plus patronage-vs-merit question
key_points.reasoning: Counts and the patronage question present; the dropped over qualifier is a Judge F matter, core meaning intact.

key_points.evidence_quote: Three hypotheses compete: cream rises, money writes, floors and ceilings
key_points.point_text: Three competing stories: cream rises, money writes history, floors and ceilings, with job analogy
key_points.reasoning: All three stories plus the twenty-candidate illustration present.

key_points.evidence_quote: Three documented mechanisms combine: mere exposure, social influence, cumulative advantage
key_points.point_text: Three mechanisms with signature stats: exposure r=0.26, MusicLab 1st-vs-40th, Matthew effect
key_points.reasoning: Mechanism names and all key stats (1968, 1989, 208, r=0.26, 14341, 48, 2006, 1st/40th, Merton) present.

key_points.evidence_quote: Producers get uncorrelated quality and capital; consumers add exposure and social signals
key_points.point_text: Model design (uncorrelated quality and capital, three agents, feedback) and run scale (1000/10000, 2 min, 360+)
key_points.reasoning: Design, uncorrelation, feedback, scale figures, and paper-versus-post status all present.

key_points.evidence_quote: With social influence visible, quality-success correlation drops (p < 0.0001, 360 runs)
key_points.point_text: Social influence weakens the quality-success link (p<0.0001) plus proxy-optimization aside
key_points.reasoning: Significance, run count, and charts-as-proxy reading present.

key_points.evidence_quote: Talent constant over 200 runs; reshuffled resources yield counterfactual distance 0.88 of 1
key_points.point_text: Canon replay: 200 runs, distance 0.88; top 10% 1-in-4 shot; 50th-90th lottery
key_points.reasoning: Design, distance, percentiles, and lottery verdict all present.

key_points.evidence_quote: Full model 0.32; no social influence 0.35; equal capital 0.46; quality only 0.46: equalizing adds 44%
key_points.point_text: Ablation 0.32/0.35/0.46/0.46 with 44% lift: capital gates access, not herd behavior
key_points.reasoning: All four values, the 44% lift, and the capital-gates interpretation present.

key_points.evidence_quote: Stylized 1750 Vienna, 300 composers: distance 0.97, only 2.5 percent shared between histories
key_points.point_text: Vienna 1750 run: 300 composers, distance 0.97, 2.5% shared; losers not meaningfully worse
key_points.reasoning: All figures plus the losers-werent-worse moral present via branch 6.

key_points.evidence_quote: Varying parameters plus-minus 50%: steep money-to-attention conversion sidelines quality
key_points.point_text: Robustness: plus-minus 50% variation; steep conversion; 50M-vs-500 illustration
key_points.reasoning: Variation band, steepness mechanism, and reach-gap example present.

key_points.evidence_quote: Quality sets a floor and a ceiling; the middle is capital and luck
key_points.point_text: Story 3 wins with implications: Bach restatement, stronger-today loops, blind-audition 5-to-25% proof, forgotten proxy
key_points.reasoning: Verdict plus all four implications present with numbers intact.

key_points.evidence_quote: Counterpoint: Quality as stable property is debatable; calibration leaps decades; genre and politics excluded
key_points.point_text: Stated caveats: debatable quality realism, Salganik-to-Vienna leap, excluded genre and politics
key_points.reasoning: All three caveat strands present in compressed form.

key_points.evidence_quote: Bach was excellent AND positioned; reshuffled patronage yields an almost entirely different canon
key_points.point_text: Closing: surgeon analogy, 20-50 unknown contemporaries, manufactured taste, honest Bieber unknown
key_points.reasoning: Analogy, count band with qualifier, taste thesis, and conceded unknown all present.
